haplotypecaller_memory_gb.title: HaplotypeCaller memory override (GB)
haplotypecaller_memory_gb.description: Leave empty for the default (72 GB, doubling automatically on each OOM retry). For deep/high-coverage samples, set a higher starting value to avoid the first attempt failing.

publish_germline_gvcf.title: Publish germline GVCF
publish_germline_gvcf.description: Copy each sample's per-sample germline GVCF (HaplotypeCaller output) to the dataset's results/haplotypecaller/ folder. Off by default -- this is an intermediate already consumed internally by joint genotyping.

publish_joint_genotyped_vcf.title: Publish joint-genotyped VCF
publish_joint_genotyped_vcf.description: Copy each pair's final joint-genotyped, VQSR-filtered VCF to the dataset's results/joint_genotyped_vcf/ folder. On by default.

read_counts_scatter_mode.title: Read-counts scatter mode
read_counts_scatter_mode.description: How COLLECT_READ_COUNTS is sharded per sample. 'groups' splits into a fixed shard count via GATK SplitIntervals, bounding job count for cohort-scale runs. 'per_chromosome' shards one-per-chromosome for maximum parallelism on a single-sample run.

cnv_scatter_mode.title: CNV-chain scatter mode
cnv_scatter_mode.description: How ITER_ISEC/EAGLE_PHASING are sharded per tumor/normal pair. 'groups' round-robins chromosomes into a fixed shard count, bounding job count for cohort-scale runs. 'per_chromosome' shards one-per-chromosome for maximum parallelism on a single-pair run.
